description:
Leidos is seeking Java Software Engineer - Scrum Master to join the Air Traffic Business Area within the Homeland Sector, supporting the development of next-generation flight service and air traffic systems. This work aligns with the FAA’s broader initiative to modernize legacy flight service capabilities, replacing aging infrastructure with scalable, cloud-based platforms designed to improve safety and operational efficiency—particularly in remote and high-dependency aviation environments. These efforts focus on delivering mission-critical, future-ready solutions that provide safety-critical flight services to the pilot community.
 
 This is a hybrid technical role where approximately 50% of your time will be spent designing, developing, testing, and maintaining production software , while the remaining 50% will be dedicated to serving as Scrum Master for an Agile development team. We are looking for experienced software engineers who enjoy facilitating Agile teams while remaining actively involved in coding, technical design, reviews, and software delivery. 
 
 As a member of a Scaled Agile software development organization, you will contribute to the technical execution of a program that integrates proven, globally deployed technologies with modern cloud-native capabilities. You will work alongside cross-functional teams and technical leaders to deliver predictable outcomes in a highly regulated, safety-critical environment. 
 
 **Please note, this exciting position is currently unfunded and is anticipation of future work. 
 
 Candidate must be able to obtain a favorable SF-85P Public Trust suitability determination from the FAA customer. Due to contract requirements, the position requires U.S. Citizenship. 
 
 Primary Responsibilities: 
 Approximately 50% hands-on software engineering: Design, develop, test, review, debug, deploy, and maintain production-quality cloud-native Java microservices while contributing to software architecture and technical design decisions.  

 Approximately 50% Scrum Master responsibilities: Facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, promote continuous improvement, and help the team deliver predictable sprint outcomes.  

 Leverage modern DevSecOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development tools, and engineering best practices to accelerate the delivery of secure, high-quality software.  

 Coordinate with the Release Train Engineer, management, and cross-functional stakeholders to communicate team status, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress.  

 Support deployment, operational troubleshooting, and resolution of critical issues in development, test, and production environments.  

 Mentor junior engineers and foster collaboration across engineering teams to ensure successful sprint execution and project delivery. 

 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field with 4+ years of relevant experience or a Master’s degree with 2+ years of prior experience                            

 3+ years of experience designing, developing, testing, and reviewing Java applications 

 1+ years of experience serving as a Scrum Master on a SAFe Agile team within a large-scale software development environment 

 Significant experience with Web development and commonly used front-end tools and languages (React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

 Significant experience with unit testing tools such as Junit and Mockito

 Experience with RESTful API, JSON, XML, XSD

 Experience with Spring Framework, Spring Security, and Spring Boot

 Experience with Linux

 Experience with version control systems such as Git or Subversion

 Experience with common development tools and IDEs (Eclipse, VS Code, etc.)

 Understanding of sound software development principles and practices

 Ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing

 Ability to obtain SF-85 Public Trust (Tier 2) suitability determination

 US citizenship required

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Knowledge of or experience with AI-assisted coding (Claude Code, Codex etc.)

 Knowledge of or experience with microservices and cloud-based environments

 Knowledge of or experience with Python programming language

 Knowledge of or experience with Ansible playbooks and YAML

 Knowledge of or experience with Linux shell scripting

 Knowledge of or experience with MongoDB

 Knowledge of air traffic control and flight services

 
 ATMC
 If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
 
 
 Original Posting: 
July 24, 2026 
 For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
